description: For aos configuration files that use $ref/$env (for plain data use json_get). Same as json_get plus: follow: true goes through $ref on the way; resolve: true returns the value with $ref/$env resolved (default: as written). Example: {"path": "fsm.json#/states/think", "follow": true}. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/aos_json_get.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone (or FILE#) = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.

follow.description: true = go through $ref on the way and at the value

max_bytes.description: print the value only if its one-line JSON is at most this many bytes (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_BYTES, else 8000)

full.description: true = print the whole value however big
